Searches for this trait: Chortophaga grasshopper spectral sensitivity ultraviolet; green-striped grasshopper spectral sensitivity ultraviolet. The ten titles of each Chortophaga search (the genus form and the green-striped grasshopper form, for three groups: visual acuity with interommatidial angle, flicker fusion with photoreceptor temporal resolution, and spectral sensitivity) were species pages for Chortophaga viridifasciata (University of Wyoming and USDA grasshopper fact sheets, Animal Diversity Web, BugGuide, Minnesota Seasons, the Montana field guide, iNaturalist, garden blogs), a College of Wooster independent study of vision in juvenile Carolina grasshoppers (a different genus), chromosome-breakage, mitosis and mutagenesis papers on Chortophaga neuroblasts (no vision), flicker-fusion pages and reviews (the Lafitte et al. systematic review, whose supplement main logs from oa-3, Miall 1978 on six laboratory insects, a honeybee temporal-acuity study), grasshopper and locust colour and wavelength papers on other genera (Melanoplus visual behaviours, Phlaeoba wavelength discrimination, an Acrida feeding-preference study, locust phototaxis spectra) and insect colour-vision pages. Two results are on the wanted list: the study of spatial vision in North American band-winged grasshoppers (for acuity and interommatidial angle) and an untitled Frontiers in Ecology and Evolution page that came up first for the flicker-fusion search (for flicker and temporal resolution). None of the other results names a Chortophaga species with a measurement, and none was opened.
